name: cn-double11-promotion-plan
description: Plan a shop's 双 11, 618 or other major platform promotion in China: targets broken down by product, the pricing and discount stack checked against platform rules and margin, the phases from 蓄水 to 返场, traffic and content plan, stock, logistics and customer service readiness, risk checks and the post-event review. Use when asked 帮我做双 11 方案, 大促活动怎么规划, 618 促销计划, 预售怎么玩, 大促复盘怎么写, or plan our Double 11 campaign. Produces a target breakdown, a price and margin table per product, a phase calendar, a channel plan, an operations readiness checklist, a risk table and a review template. Distinct from promotion-plan, which is for general retail promotions.
